anomalies.detail: 2025-03-18 was a REAL NSE trading day (March 2025 holidays were only the 14th and 31st) with missing Yahoo data. 2026-05-01 and 2026-10-02 ARE real holidays wrongly admitted to the trading calendar. The backtest marks all 7 non-tradeable so no fill can occur on them; 02c_calendar.py still needs fixing.
Today's NIFTY100 constituents are used for the whole history. No headline alpha should be published until point-in-time index circulars are loaded.
Only 4 web-verified (SIEMENS wrong ratio, RELIANCE/Jio, ADANIENT Dec-2023 election, ADANIENT Nov-2024 DOJ). IDEA has 33 unverified, ADANIENT 15.

The engine marked positions against Close[t-1] rather than the last valid close, so each unpriced session broke the return chain. NIFTY100 buy-and-hold was understated by 23 percentage points (167.06% vs the correct 189.83%).
